glsa.title: Brotli: Remote code execution
glsa.synopsis: A vulnerability has been discovered in Brotli, allowing remote code execution.

background.p: Brotli is a generic-purpose lossless compression algorithm.

description.p: A vulnerability has been discovered in Brotli. Please review the CVE identifier referenced below for details.

impact.p: A remote attacker could achieve code execution.

workaround.p: There is no known workaround at this time.

resolution.p: All Brotli users should upgrade to the latest version:
